policy.description: Airway-prioritized simulation reference panel with explicitly labelled background diversity.
notes: Inclusion does not assert airway isolation, healthy carriage, or clinical relevance for every species.
Background organisms supplement priority genera to reach the requested benchmark size.
Eligibility follows DECOI's exact-primer, unambiguous-contig, and one-V4-allele restrictions.
Species with identical V4 markers cannot both be retained in this initial model.
This panel does not calibrate the inherited SparseDOSSA2 Stool abundance template to lung ecology.
